title: Folders for a new Herdr workspace
description: HERDR-6: `GET /v1/herdr/folders[?under=<folder>&hidden=1]`. Without `under`: `recent` - the folders the running sessions' panes are in, newest first (by when the daemon first saw a pane there), at most eight, never the home folder itself - and `common`, the ones of `~`, `~/Work`, `~/Projects`, `~/code`, `~/src`, `~/dev` this host has; `browse` is null. With `under` (`~`, `~/x`, absolute, or relative to the home folder): `browse` is that folder and the folders directly inside it - names starting with `.` only with `hidden=1`, never a private place (`~/.ssh`, `~/.gnupg`, credentials, browser profiles, Omodachi's own state), no link out of $HOME, sorted by name, at most 100 (`truncated`); `recent` and `common` are null. `path` is resolved (a link shows its own `display` and `name` and its target's `path`); `display` is the `~` form a person reads. Native and web credentials. HERDR-11: without `under`, also `favourites` - the folders a person starred, for every device of this host, in the order they were starred (at most 12; `POST /v1/herdr/folders/favourites {path, favourite}` stars or un-stars one and answers with this document) - and `launchers`, what a new workspace may start with: the operator's `launchers.toml` rows (Collie's format, `~/.config/omodachi/`, else `~/.config/collie/`), or without that file `codex` and `claude`, each only when installed. Both are null with `under`; a core from before HERDR-11 sends neither.
